Corollary

1. ch8:8.39Every Lie group has a smooth left-invariant global frame and is therefore parallelizable.

Proof

\sketch Under the evaluation isomorphism, any basis of $T_eG$ corresponds to a basis of $\operatorname {Lie}(G)$ whose pointwise values form a global frame.

□
